verdict.rationale: Stagehand is itself a first-party SDK, documented as offering familiar APIs across TypeScript, Python, and Go. The docs back this with a quickstart, API reference pages, AI coding-assistant rules for v4, and the CrewAI tool wrapping the official Python SDK; community users report hands-on use of the library. Missing for 10: language-specific evidence for the Go SDK and the per-language parity of the Python SDK, and package and versioning details for each SDK.
